verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API with scoped API keys, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. The axis applies because Granola ships a public API, so this lack of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
